![Nemux Ledger emblem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nemu-x/nemux-ledger/main/assets/nemux-ledger-logo-512.png)

# Nemux Ledger

  A guild companion addon for **World of Warcraft: Forever**.

  Readiness HUD · deaths · recipe search · feats · leaderboards · weekly report · loot log

  [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/nemux-ledger) ·
  [MIT License](https://github.com/Nemu-x/nemux-ledger/blob/main/LICENSE)

---

## What it does

- **Readiness HUD.** A small panel that shows up only when something is missing or about to run out: food buff, flask, elixir, weapon oil, potions, Well-Rested. You choose the checks for solo, party and raid.
- **Guild roster and recipe search.** "Who can craft Silver Rod?" Recipes are shared when a member opens their profession window, so offline crafters are found too. Hover a recipe to see its reagents, what you have in bags and bank, and an approximate cost (with Auctionator).
- **Recipe tracker.** A shopping list on screen that updates as you loot and buy.
- **Leaderboards.** Deaths (all time and this week) and honorable kills, a guild death feed, and a weekly report ready for Discord.
- **Feats.** 33 small achievements plus guild goals with progress bars.
- **Level-up alerts** for the whole guild (can be turned off).
- **Loot log.** Reads awards from **Gargul** and **RCLootCouncil**. Nemux Ledger never hands out loot itself.

Everything that involves other players works between guild mates who also run the addon. The UI is in English.

## Install

- **CurseForge app:** search for *Nemux Ledger*.
- **Manually:** download the zip from Releases or CurseForge and extract the `RequiemLedger` folder into
  `Interface\AddOns\` inside your WoW: Forever game folder.

> The folder, SavedVariables and addon-message prefix are still named `RequiemLedger` / `RQLedger`, so data from early builds is kept.

Type `/rq` to open the window, or `/rq help` to list the commands.

## Privacy: what is sent to the guild

Hidden addon messages on the guild channel and in whispers, only to guild mates who run Nemux Ledger:
addon version, death count and death location type, profession skill levels, known recipe IDs, feats, honorable kill count.

It never sends chat text, gold, items or anything from other addons. Incoming data is checked against strict formats and only ever displayed as text. Nothing received is ever run as code.

## Repository layout

```
RequiemLedger/     the addon itself (this folder goes into Interface\AddOns)
  Core/            init, DB, API compatibility layer, slash commands
  Data/            consumable tables, death phrases
  Modules/         readiness, deaths, guild sync, recipes, feats, boards, weekly, tracker, loot
  UI/              main window, HUD, minimap button, theme, export
tests/             mock WoW client (fengari) and unit tests
docs/              CurseForge description, research notes, tester guide
assets/            logo and emblem sources
```

## Development

Tests run the addon in a fake WoW client inside [fengari](https://github.com/fengari-lua/fengari) (Lua 5.3 in JavaScript):

```sh
cd tests
npm install
npm test
```

Passing mock tests do not prove the addon works in game; every feature is also checked in the live client.

Targets: WoW: Forever 1.60.x, `## Interface: 16001` (Mainline 12.x API).

releases.notes:
# Nemux Ledger 0.6.2

**Guild mates' recipe books**
- In Professions → Guild crafters, click a member to open **their recipe book** for that profession. It works even when they are offline.
- The book is laid out like the game's profession window: recipes grouped in collapsible categories on the left (with icons, quality colours and a green dot when your bags hold the reagents), the chosen recipe on the right with its reagents (bags, bank and how many are needed), the approximate cost, who else knows it, and a Track button.
- Categories are the game's own for professions you have (read when you open your window). For other professions they come from what the recipe makes (Parts, Explosives, Chest, Potion...) and, for enchants, from the slot.
- Hover a recipe for the game's tooltip of the item. Shift-click it to link it in chat. Search inside the book, « Back returns to the list.
- Member rows show how many recipes are known ("29 recipes »"), or "not synced" when the member hasn't shared yet: they need Nemux Ledger and to open that profession window once.
- **Shift-click** a member to try the game's own profession window. Forever doesn't always answer this, which is why the addon's own book is the default.
- Fixed: a guild mate's profession window shown by the game could be read as your own recipes.
- The secondary profession cards are wider, so "First Aid", "Fishing" and "Cooking" are no longer cut off.

# Nemux Ledger 0.6.1

**New Professions tab**
- Your professions are shown as cards: two main professions with skill bars, plus Cooking, First Aid and Fishing.
- **Click a card to open that profession window.** Click it again to close it. The card of the open window has a crimson border.
- Gathering skills (Herbalism, Skinning, Fishing) have no window to open. Professions can't be opened in combat.
- Recipe search ("who can craft...") and the guild crafters list moved here from the Guild tab. The Guild tab now shows the members list only.
- The profession bars on the Me tab can be clicked too.
- `/rq profs` opens the tab. `/rq recipes <name>` searches recipes, as before.

# Nemux Ledger 0.6.0

**RCLootCouncil integration**
- The loot log now follows RCLootCouncil live on WoW: Forever. Every raid member with RCLootCouncil sees each award as it happens, not only the master looter.
- The Response column shows RCLootCouncil's own response and colour (Mainspec, Offspec, Minor Upgrade, ...).
- The item tooltip shows council votes, the note, the boss and raid, and who handed the item out.
- Awards that are deleted or edited in RCLootCouncil's history window are updated here too.
- Personal loot and bonus rolls are left out.

**Minimap button**
- It now uses the standard LibDBIcon library. Minimap button bags pick it up as "Nemux Ledger" instead of showing a warning about a custom button.
- Your button position is kept.

**Window**
- A new header with the emblem inside the frame and a flat close button.
- Tabs now look like tabs.
- Selected buttons are highlighted in crimson instead of fading the others.
- Flat search fields with placeholder text.
- The background is more opaque, so other UI no longer shows through.
- The Boards tab is tidied up: the "Remind on reset" option no longer sticks out of the window, and names in the guild death feed are no longer cut off.
